text:
Maya Khan: FYI — Onyx is asking for a conservative dedicated-pool load sweep + fallback tuning next Wed. They want quota-window alignment, autoscale validation, and a canary before full cutover. Proposed quick plan:
- shadow 10% traffic for 30m
- ramp to 50% for 15m
- hold/observe 15m then decide
Can someone own the run, monitoring (p95/p99/error-rate) and the rollback path if latency spikes? Also need SRE to prepare routing fallback to hosted models. They want a short post-run notes doc and a 30m screen share.

Tom Burke: I can own comms + runbook. I'll send the invite. Can SRE confirm the autoscale thresholds we validated in the last dry run? cc @rohit-singh

Rohit Singh: I can own infra side. Quick notes:
- Shadow routing trick: set header `X-Redwood-Shadow: on` so we mirror traffic to dedicated pool without affecting production routing.
- Autoscale thresholds I propose (conservative): scale-up when GPU util > 70% averaged over 2m, scale-step +20% replicas, scale-down when util < 40% for 5m.
- Alerts: p95 > 400ms OR error-rate > 0.5% triggers immediate rollback to hosted.
- Load test command (k6):
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m scripts/onyx_sweep.js --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086 
```
This pushes detailed metrics to our dashboard. I'll provision a shadow slot and pre-warm nodes 30m before start.

Aisha Zhang: I'll own priming + quality checks. Plan:
- run a warmup script to populate KV/prefix caches (top 50 prefixes) 20m before sweep
- run eval batch `onyx_eval_v3` right after each ramp step and compare embeddings/regression metrics.
Priming curl snippet (for ops):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" -d '{"prompt":"prime: onboarding:user_profile","max_tokens":32}'
```
This reduces cold-start p99s from the last run.

Maya Khan: Add a quality gate: if eval metric (semantic-sim F1) drops >2% vs baseline, we rollback immediately. Also capture token-cost delta and note any latency tail increases.

deploy-bot: Deploy success: dedicated-pool/onyx-v2 promoted -> instances: 6 -> 6 (no scale event)

Tom Burke: Scheduling suggestion: Wed 2025-07-16 22:00 UTC (off-peak for Onyx but within ops window). Anyone object? I'll draft runbook steps and RTE contact list. Also note renewal touchpoint after run — Onyx flagged this as a high-visibility milestone.

Rohit Singh: Works for me. I'll monitor GPU mem, TPS, p95/p99, and set dashboard panels for quick triage. I'll also enable a short chaos test (interrupt one replica) at 60% ramp to validate fallback.

Aisha Zhang: I'll upload priming script to S3 and share link in the runbook. I'll also prepare the eval harness and a short script to diff results against baseline.

Maya Khan: Perfect — I'll capture notes during the run and post a 1-page summary with action items and the metrics snapshot. :thumbsup:

Tom Burke: ack. I'll create the calendar invite and add Onyx PM + ops. :calendar:

Rohit Singh: One more ops note — increase autoscale cooldown to 180s for this test so we don't oscillate during the ramp.

Maya Khan: Noted. Thanks all — we'll do a 15m pre-brief 30m before the window.

Tom Burke: Calendar invite sent. I'll include runbook link and participants.

Aisha Zhang: Uploaded priming script -> s3://redwood-runbooks/onyx/priming_v1.sh

Maya Khan: Great, closing the loop. See you for pre-brief.
